سُلَاخَةٌ [app. A piece of skin, or hide, stripped off]. (K voce جَرٌّ.) ＝
-A2- The urine of the mountaingoat. (KL.) [In Pers. سَلَاحَهٌ: thus, with ح, and with fet-h to the first letter, accord. to Johnson's Pers. Ar. and Engl. Dict. Golius adds, on the authority of Ibn-Beytár, that it is black and viscous like pitch, and is collected from the rocks.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
